"Bank shot, bank card, bank turn..." - not plastic.

Hmm, what about "revolving"? Revolving credit, revolving card... no.

"Cheap shot, cheap card, cheap plastic, cheap turn..." 

"Key card, key turn..." 

Wait - maybe they all can follow "WILD": wild card, wild shot, wild turn, wild plastic? No.

"Gold card, gold plastic, gold turn..." 

Let me try: these can all be preceded by "SURGERY"? No... "plastic surgery"...

"Face card, face shot, face turn, face plastic" - face card (yes), face shot (yes), face turn (yes, in wrestling!), face plastic... no.

Actually: "face card, face shot, face turn" - and face plastic? Maybe not.

But wait: "trump card, trump shot, trump turn, trump plastic"? No.

Actually "WILD": wild card, wild shot, wild turn, wild plastic? No.
